title: Candle Making Class
description: During this class you will get to choose your scent, mix your wax, and pour two same scent 8.5oz soy candles! You will be walked through a step-by-step process and learn fun facts along the way. You know we’ll have lots…
fullDescription: During this class you will get to choose your scent, mix your wax, and pour two same scent 8.5oz soy candles! You will be walked through a step-by-step process and learn fun facts along the way. You know we’ll have lots of scents to choose from! One seat = $60, no spectators plz No food. BYOB (wine, beer, champs. please bring your own cups I don’t keep any at the store) Classes last around an hour , and you are welcome to stay and shop afterwards! Your candles will cool over night, and you can pick them up the next day, or within the next week. Start Time & Cancellations - Classes start on time. Please call/text me (904) 316-7608 if you’re running late, I lock the door during classes. This part of town is popular, so allow time to find parking. I don’t accept cancellations or rescheduling for private classes. For public classes, you may reschedule if notified a week in advance. By signing up, you agree to these terms.
location: The Candle Garden · Atlantic Beach, FL
